title: Bergman functions on weakly uniformly perfect domains II
summary: We study the boundary asymptotic behavior of Bergman functions on planar domains. Motivated by Chen's question on the equivalence between uniform perfectness of the boundary and the sharp growth rates of the Bergman kernel and the Bergman metric, we focus on the second part of the question concerning the Bergman metric. We prove that $\partialΩ$ is uniformly perfect if and only if $K_Ω^{(1)}(w)\asymp δ_Ω(w)^{-4}$.
